🚀 arozos | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a functional and user-friendly desktop operating system experience on low-power devices, enabling them to act as personal cloud storage, home servers, or network-attached storage solutions.
✨ Key Features: • Web Desktop Interface • File Manager with drag-and-drop, upload • Realtime Network Statistics • Static Web Server with built-in editor • Mount Local and Remote File Systems (WebDAV, SMB, SFTP)
📖 Summary: ArozOS is a web-based desktop operating system designed for low-power platforms like Raspberry Pi. It provides a user-friendly interface with features for file management, networking, and security, aiming to create a personal cloud or home server experience.
